title: Number of Datasets on data.gov.my
description: Monthly and cumulative number of datasets published via the data catalogue

fields.name: datasets
fields.title: Datasets (monthly)
fields.description: [Integer] Number of new datasets published in the given month

fields.name: datasets_cumul
fields.title: Datasets (cumulative)
fields.description: [Integer] Cumulative total number of datasets published up to (and including) the given month

methodology: This data is aggregated from the list of datasets extracted from the site's internal API.
publication: The count of datasets here is fully consistent with the site's [data catalogue](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/).
